sources.title: Quantum algorithms for supervised and unsupervised machine learning
sources.finding: The distance construction keeps vector norms separately and uses an ancilla; normalized state overlap alone is not substituted for arbitrary Euclidean vector distance. Claimed complexity assumes quantum data access/state preparation.
sources.implication_for_us: Our affine anchor is a design device preserving functional sign/norm information, not a new generic discovery that quantum distances require normalization information. Equal-information classical kernels must be measured.

sources.title: Semi-classical geometric tensor in multiparameter quantum information
sources.finding: The measured classical Fisher matrix is distinguished from the state quantum Fisher matrix; measurement choice and phase-dependent information determine their gap.
sources.implication_for_us: Our real RY/CZ equality in encoding-angle coordinates is an explicit special-case derivation. It does not extend to all complex circuits or all trainable parameters. Discrete top-k geometry remains a different object.

sources.title: When Are Experts Misrouted? Counterfactual Routing Analysis in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
sources.finding: EPO starts from a frozen reference router, samples alternative complete top-k routes, recomputes mixture weights and trains on better realized-label routes using a CE-gap-weighted preference loss. It studies verified mathematical reasoning trajectories.
sources.implication_for_us: Our unconditional first-order squared-error regression on small WikiText LM states tests a different target/estimator. A near-zero predictor result does not constitute a failed EPO reproduction or refute counterfactual preference learning.

own_new_evidence.energy_decomposition: On dev3seeds, local energy-only vs full-distance rank correlation is about.885-.908 raw and.895-.914 centered; raw cross/energy magnitude ratio is only.056-.064. Await KL/Fisher enrichment before interpreting family compatibility.
own_new_evidence.research_direction: Prioritize information-preserving measurement/readout, actual discrete exchange boundaries, and norm-controlled functional compatibility over arbitrary state-geodesic claims.

citation_policy: Use the linked primary papers and attribute our derivations separately; no novelty claim for generic Fisher geometry, ancilla/norm encoding, or counterfactual routing.
